newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED CRASH 3-2 AT HOME TO DERBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED CRASH 3-2 AT HOME TO DERBY.

text.p: Manchester United crashed 3-2 at home to Derby on Saturday -- a result which breathed new life into the English title race.
Costa Rican striker Paulo Cesar Wanchope struck a stunning individual goal on his premier league debut. Ashley Ward and Dean Sturridge were relegation-threatened Derby's other scorers.

United, in European Cup semifinal action against Borussia Dortmund on Wednesday, remained top, three points clear. But Liverpool will overtake them for the first time since January if they beat Coventry by two goals or more on Sunday.
Arsenal stayed in the hunt after their 3-0 win at Chelsea earlier on Saturday. The Gunners, who went into second place, are three points behind United having played a game more.
England striker Alan Shearer scored on his return to action after a groin operation but his Newcastle side were held 1-1 by Sunderland in the big north-east derby.
